articles.title: Pre-orders are live: Standard & Ultimate Edition
articles.body: Grand Theft Auto VI is now open for pre-order on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Two editions: Standard Edition (the game) and Ultimate Edition (the game plus a large bundle of in-story bonus content). Already got the Standard Edition? The Ultimate Edition Upgrade is a separate purchase you can make any time after redeeming your code, so there's no need to decide before launch. Digital pre-orders made before November 20 also come with the Vintage Vice City Pack: a '55 Vapid Stanier Sedan and garage, period outfits and hairstyles, an exclusive weapon pattern, and one month of GTA+. One thing to watch: digital code redemption is tied to your platform account's region, so buy from your own region's store to avoid activation issues.

articles.title: What's actually in the Ultimate Edition
articles.body: Rockstar's confirmed the full Ultimate Edition list, and it's more than a car and an outfit: bonuses are threaded through Jason and Lucia's story, unlocking chapter by chapter rather than dumped in your inventory on day one. Confirmed so far: the '95 Grotti Cheetah, Hawk & Little Morgan revolvers with personalized weapon variants, Vice City styles, Jason's safehouse vehicles, the Ganado Retro Build, Rideout Customs mod shop, Sara's Unisex Salon, a Shitzu Squalo, the Stock 305 clothing store, a '67 Vapid Dominator buggy with garage, Electric Fang tattoo parlor, One-Eyed Willie's mod shop, Goodtime Gear, the PTT Youngin$ compound, and a classic car collection. No physical Ultimate Edition exists — physical Standard Edition owners upgrade digitally through the PlayStation or Microsoft store after redeeming their code.

articles.title: Preload is live
articles.body: Confirmed straight from Rockstar: pre-load unlocks at local midnight on November 12, for both digital pre-orders and physical copies. Retail boxes ship with a download code, no disc included. Redeem your code as soon as you have it to be first in line. Pre-ordered digitally before November 20? Don't forget the Vintage Vice City Pack bonus is tied to that window.

articles.title: New gameplay trailer has fans buzzing
articles.body: The latest trailer gave the clearest look yet at Leonida (Vice City's neon sprawl, the Keys and the swampy interior), following protagonists Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval. The community's been dissecting every frame for map and mission clues ever since. We've logged every landmark we could pin so the map's ready to go on day one.

articles.title: 40 new collectibles mapped
articles.body: We just pushed 40 verified collectible locations across Vice City. Pull to refresh your map. Landmarks and Activities got the biggest additions, with more regions rolling in over the following days as the community maps them.
